visual_action: A slideshow of three still photographs showing President Joe Biden with members of the United Auto Workers (UAW) on a picket line. In the first photo, he speaks into a megaphone. In the second, he fist-bumps a union member. In the third, he poses for a group photo with several workers holding signs.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Joe Biden is visually present in all photos and named in the on-screen text: 'President Biden'.

cast.name: United Auto Workers
cast.evidence: The abbreviation 'UAW' appears on signs held by protesters and in the on-screen text 'with UAW members'.

on_screen_text.text: Today, President Biden joined the picket line
President Biden is the most pro-union president in American history 💙

spoken_summary: There is no speech or dialogue in the video; only instrumental and vocal music plays.
audio_music: The video is set to the song 'Scott Street' by Phoebe Bridgers. The music has a gentle, sincere, and slightly melancholic indie-folk tone, which creates a positive and historic feel for the visuals.
editing_pacing: The video is a slow-paced slideshow of three static photographs.
cultural_references: The song 'Scott Street' by Phoebe Bridgers is used as the soundtrack.
central_claim: President Biden is the most pro-union president in American history, as evidenced by his unprecedented action of joining a UAW picket line.
intended_effect: To portray President Biden as a strong and historic ally of labor unions and the working class, thereby generating support and admiration.
